_about: Why a live store isn't saving (checked 11-20 from its last GitHub runs). Shown in the sheet's column R as 'Not saving since <date>: <reason>' (or 'Never saved: <reason>') while the store has no saved run for 36 h; ignored once it saves again. Edit when a reason changes.
avoira: the store's data service answers 'Internal server error' (their side)
itdevicesonline: one category only 58% read, so the run is refused as partial
renewtech: run too slow, GitHub stops it after 6 hours
enterasource: the store's data service gives empty answers
boosthardware: our scraper has a bug ('list' has no 'replace'), needs a fix
bytestock: the store's data service gives empty answers
deploydepot: the store rejects our product request (400 Bad Request)
esus: our scraper can't read prices written like '1 154.84', needs a fix
globalnetpro: run cancelled before it finished (too slow)
redcorp: the store rejects our product request (400 Bad Request)
senetic: 63k of 101k product pages fail to load, so the run is refused
